name: SEC EDGAR Form 10-K Annual Report
trust_note: Audited annual report filed with the SEC. Primary source for US public company supply chain disclosures
column9: and business descriptions. Highest regulatory standard — subject to SEC enforcement and external audit.

name: SEC EDGAR Form 10-Q Quarterly Report
trust_note: Unaudited interim quarterly report filed with the SEC. Primary source for material developments between annual reports. Less complete than 10-K but filed three times per year.

name: SEC EDGAR Form 8-K Current Report
trust_note: Material event disclosure required within 4 business days of triggering event. Covers acquisitions
column10: and other material developments. Highly time-sensitive evidence source.

name: Federal Reserve Publications
trust_note: Official US central bank publications covering monetary policy decisions
column9: and financial stability reports. Authoritative source for interest rate risk and macroeconomic exposure evidence.
